records.title: ExAnte: A Benchmark for Ex-Ante Inference in Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper is an ex-ante inference benchmark of LLM decision behavior, not a benchmark of latency, throughput, memory, or hardware execution efficiency.

records.title: Sensorimotor Attention and Language-based Regressions in Shared Latent Variables for Integrating Robot Motion Learning and LLM
records.reason: The paper studies language and sensorimotor latent variables for robot motion learning; its LLM use is part of a robotics application rather than inference systems efficiency.

records.title: Circuit Partitioning Using Large Language Models for Quantum Compilation and Simulations
records.reason: The paper uses LLMs to partition quantum circuits for compilation/simulation; the abstract evaluates task accuracy, not LLM inference runtime or resource efficiency.

records.title: Less Is More? Examining Fairness in Pruned Large Language Models for Summarising Opinions
records.reason: The abstract studies fairness effects of pruning LLMs for opinion summarization and proposes pruning to improve fairness; it does not establish efficiency as the contribution or evaluation target.

records.title: M-Wanda: Improving One-Shot Pruning for Multilingual LLMs
records.reason: M-Wanda proposes layerwise one-shot LLM pruning with language-aware activation statistics to preserve multilingual capability under sparsity, directly compressing inference models.

records.title: Decomposed Attention Fusion in MLLMs for Training-Free Video Reasoning Segmentation
records.reason: DecAF refines MLLM attention maps for video segmentation accuracy without retraining; the contribution is a downstream segmentation method, with no inference efficiency target established.

records.title: Planning-Guided Tutoring with Assessment-Driven Memory for Pedagogical LLM Tutors
records.reason: The ACL abstract proposes planning and assessment-driven memory to improve pedagogical tutoring conversations; it is an education application and quality contribution, not serving efficiency.

records.title: Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping: Agent-Triggered Focus Sessions for Isolated Per-Agent Steering in Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration
records.reason: The abstract proposes per-agent context isolation and reports context-efficiency ratios for multi-agent LLM orchestration; its connection to reducing inference context/compute is plausible, but deployment and inference-cost evidence remains abstract-level.

records.title: Progressive Behavioral Drift through Compression Valleys in Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper exploits attention sinks and compression valleys for activation-space behavioral attacks; this is an LLM security vulnerability study, not inference optimization.

records.title: Menos: Split Fine-Tuning Large Language Models with Efficient GPU Memory Sharing
records.reason: The ACM abstract is a split fine-tuning system that shares model/GPU memory during training across clients; it addresses fine-tuning rather than inference.
